### Get tasking attempts
-	This path is used for ONEDAY and ONENOWATTEMPTS requests
-	This API allows to get the first possible attempts matching your criteria
- Note that, as of today, the API responds in some cases with a 500 error
-	Even if the parameter is mandatory, maxCloudCover is NOT yet used for calculations.
-	StartDate can be set at any time. Note that if you try to set it in the past, the value will be replace by the current date
